option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom, not a specific diagnosis in the context of the provided leaves.

RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) is a distinct genetic disorder involving vascular malformations, but it is not equivalent to Sturge-Weber syndrome, which is the only provided leaf.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a specific finding/manifestation, not a comprehensive diagnosis equivalent to Sturge-Weber syndrome.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) is a distinct genetic syndrome not equivalent to Sturge-Weber syndrome.
